note: Educational SourceClaims (spoken teaching) tested against Campaign 001 (win) and 002 (loss). A spoken claim is NOT promoted to a confirmed rule. Two campaigns + one video -> NO final strategy declared.

tests.question: Does Farouk teach that a session break requires displacement/FVG confirmation?
tests.edu_evidence: Requires a RETEST + confirmation (OB/CHoCH) after a break (EDU-C-003/005); FVG/BPR cited as long signals (EDU-C-006). The word 'displacement' does NOT appear; no explicit 'a break REQUIRES displacement/FVG to be valid'.
tests.c002: external_review(UNVERIFIED) claims the loss followed a break with NO downside FVG
tests.verdict: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for the strict 'displacement required' wording; PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED that confirmation/FVG matter

tests.question: Does he teach CHoCH as a required entry confirmation?
tests.edu_evidence: CHoCH ('change of character') is taught as A confirmation (EDU-C-005), among OB-retest and other confirmations; not stated as the sole mandatory trigger.
tests.c001: panel showed a CHoCH value near the entry (not proven to be the trigger)
tests.c002: panel showed a CHoCH value (relationship to entry unclear)
tests.verdict: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED as a confirmation; INSUFFICIENT to call CHoCH strictly required

tests.question: Does he require an OB retest inside/near the intended entry zone?
tests.edu_evidence: Strongly taught: entry = retest of the OB after BOS (EDU-C-003); the OB zone IS the entry area.
tests.c001: SUPPORTED — panel 'OB retest 4123.51' sits INSIDE the entry zone 4116-4126 (winning trade)
tests.c002: NOT_SUPPORTED — panel 'OB retest 4053.58' is NOT at the 3970-3980 sell (losing trade)
tests.verdict: SUPPORTED_IN_TEACHING; consistent with C001 (win) and its absence in C002 (loss) — candidate discriminator, not a rule

tests.question: Is entering far from the higher-timeframe location discouraged?
tests.edu_evidence: Implied: 'higher timeframe is stronger', wait for price to REACH the OB/HTF levels (EDU-C-004).
tests.c001: entered near an HTF supply that held (win) — consistent
tests.c002: entered FAR below the HTF bearish zones (loss) — consistent with a discouraged location
tests.verdict: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED (implied in teaching; directionally consistent with both campaigns)

tests.question: Does missing displacement turn a break into a trap?
tests.edu_evidence: The 'trap' concept is taught (EDU-C-007: liquidity grab before a big move), but the explicit causal link 'missing displacement/FVG => trap' is NOT clearly stated in this video.
tests.c002: external_review(UNVERIFIED) makes exactly this claim for the loss
tests.verdict: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE — trap concept present; the displacement-absence link is only in the (unverified) C002 external review

tests.question: Is TP1-then-breakeven standard management?
tests.edu_evidence: Taught: move stop to breakeven on the retest (EDU-C-008); take profit at known levels (EDU-C-011).
tests.c001: SUPPORTED — Discord: 'take TP1 ... move stop to breakeven'
tests.c002: SUPPORTED — Discord LEG A: 'Take TP1 now' + 'Move sl to entry'

tests.question: Is recovery/re-entry core method or an exceptional protocol?
tests.edu_evidence: Taught as a response to stop-outs/mistakes (EDU-C-010: 'if we hit stop loss we look for a recovery trade' / 're-enter ... even I make mistakes').
tests.c002: SUPPORTED — LEG B was a re-entry after LEG A
tests.verdict: SUPPORTED as a defined CONTINGENCY/recovery protocol (conditional on a stop-out), NOT the primary A+ setup

remaining_gaps: 'displacement' never spoken -> the displacement/FVG-required and displacement=>trap links rest on the UNVERIFIED C002 external review
No market data for any campaign -> structural claims not price-verified
Transcript is base.en (some SMC terms phonetic) -> a higher-accuracy pass could recover more nuance
Discord/chart timezones still not reconciled (EDU platform shows UTC+2; Discord TZ unknown)
